You will oversee the design, development, and production of hardware necessary to support current and new products. You will also be responsible for providing overall guidance to software engineering as well act as the technical interface with the customer. You will:
Design, troubleshoot and test circuits and related hardware for new products.
Modify existing circuit boards and related hardware for existing products as required by technology and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain detailed documentation of hardware designs, testing procedures, and outcomes.
Collaborate with software engineers to focus on achieving or exceeding timelines.
Serve as the technical interface with the customer.
cond_0075.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience in hardware design, development, and testing, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of design and simulation tools such as Altium, Cadence, and SPICE.
Background in VOIP, networks, and routers.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with security and reliability considerations in hardware design.
Willingness to apply a methodical approach to problem-solving and an openness to working through challenges as they arise.
Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
Comfort managing multiple projects at the same time.

cond_0195.responsibilities:
Design, troubleshoot and test circuits and related hardware for new products.
Modify existing circuit boards and related hardware for existing products as required by technology and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain detailed documentation of hardware designs, testing procedures, and outcomes.
Stay in close contact with software engineers to align on timelines and actively contribute to keeping projects on track.
Serve as the primary technical interface with the customer, handling questions and walking them through decisions as needed.
cond_0195.requirements:
Proven experience in hardware design, development, and testing.
Demonstrated proficiency in using design and simulation tools, e.g. Altium, Cadence, and SPICE.
Extensive experience with VOIP, networks, and routers.
Operate with a security and reliability-first mindset.
Strong problem-solving skills with intellectual curiosity and a methodical approach to problem resolution.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical trade-offs to others.
Excellent organizational skills and a logical thinker.
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and timeliness.
Able to handle multiple projects at the same time.
cond_0195.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0195.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.

cond_0291.intro: We are looking for a Hardware Engineer (Circuit Design) to join our team.
cond_0291.responsibilities:
You will oversee the design, development, and production of hardware necessary to support current and new products. You will also be responsible for providing overall guidance to software engineering as well act as the technical interface with the customer. You will:
Design, troubleshoot and test circuits and related hardware for new products.
Modify existing circuit boards and related hardware for existing products as required by technology and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain detailed documentation of hardware designs, testing procedures, and outcomes.
Collaborate with software engineers to focus on achieving or exceeding timelines.
Serve as the technical interface with the customer.
cond_0291.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience in hardware design, development, and testing, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of design and simulation tools such as Altium, Cadence, and SPICE.
Background in VOIP, networks, and routers.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with security and reliability considerations in hardware design.
Willingness to apply a methodical approach to problem-solving and an openness to working through challenges as they arise.
Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
Comfort managing multiple projects at the same time.
